images.caption:
This is the ASEAN symbol of unity depicting the then, the six members of the asean member countries that being inaugurated after the admission of Brunei in the association of Southeast Asia. Thus, totaling the nation counter up to Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand the Philippines, Malaysia, and Brunei. 
The symbol was a statement for the unity of asean states amidst an era  of uncertainty, war, and instability. pen enshrines hope that through togetherness and cooperation and, of course, unity, each of these 6 nations will guide each other towards a better tomorrow.
